Hemmsen, Mike L. Rank, Marit Otto and Preben Kidmose · Ear-EEG Sleep Monitoring 2023 (EESM23), OpenNeuro ds005178 v1.0.0, doi:10.18112/openneuro.ds005178.v1.0.0. Study: Kaare Bjarke Mikkelsen, Yousef Rezai Tabar, Laura Rævsbæk Birch, Simon Lind Kappel, Christian Bech Christensen, Lars Dalskov Mosgaard, Marit Otto, Martin Christian Hemmsen, Mike Lind Rank and Preben Kidmose · Ear-EEG sleep monitoring data sets, Scientific Data 12, 301 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04579-8. Processed export: Zachary1150/EESM23-Processed on Hugging Face, which did not create the original cohort.
sources.attributionNote: The dataset record and the data-descriptor paper carry different author lists (13 and 10 people). Both are cited as their own records give them; neither is substituted for the other.
sources.privacyReview: All subjects gave written, informed consent. Approved by the Central Denmark Region Committees on Biomedical Research Ethics (1-10-72-13-20) and the Danish Medicines Agency (2020012619). Publication was not mentioned in the informed consent form; before release, the GDPR office of Region Midt judged the data set fully anonymized. Consent therefore covered the study, and the public release rests on that anonymization judgment. Only cohort aggregates are published here: no per-person scores, no per-person distribution percentiles, no per-night or per-epoch values.
verification: Dataset author list, licence and DOI read from the OpenNeuro dataset_description.json on 2026-09-22.
Paper title, author list, volume and article number read from Crossref for doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04579-8 on 2026-09-22.
Consent, ethics case numbers and the GDPR anonymization statement read from the open-access full text (Europe PMC PMC11840015) on 2026-09-22.
The paper's CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 licence covers the article text; the data set is CC0. This project cites the article and uses the data.

sources.holdReason: The consent statement for this cohort has been found only in a third-party catalog (EEGDash). The primary report (HAL hal-02086581) could not be retrieved: the site serves a bot-protection challenge, which this session does not bypass. The authors' Zenodo record and GitHub repository contain no consent statement. The maintainer is reading the primary report directly; the decision will be recorded here when that is done.
